assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for Orbit Bloom, an original cheerful cartoon garden adventure game. Create ONE landscape 4:3 sprite sheet, exactly FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows, one distinct isolated object perfectly centered in each equal rectangular cell with at least 12% transparent margin on every side. All cells same size. No grid lines, labels, words, backdrop, ground or cast shadow. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom: row1 a chunky curled lime-green leaf with one bold central vein and short stem; a plump sky-blue dewdrop with one big white gleam; a squat glossy cherry-red apple with chunky brown stem and one green leaf; a round coral-pink rose with FIVE large rounded spiral petals and two little green leaves. Row2 a squat faceted violet diamond with a wide chunky top; a navy-blue spherical cartoon bomb with gold collar, curved short fuse and simple orange star spark; three thick bright-red rounded dynamite sticks bound by one cream ribbon with a little fuse, NO lettering; a large golden-orange spherical mega bomb with broad copper bands and a simple star spark. Row3 a smooth jewel-like rainbow sphere with six broad saturated colored segments and a large cartoon highlight; a compact mint-and-cream toy garden rover TOP-DOWN with four chunky dark wheels and a small crate of cartoon fruit in back; a friendly cream-and-mint round gardening robot with TWO BIG amber eyes, tiny wheels and a green sprout on its head; a thick cheerful bright gold coin with one big green leaf emblem. Style: lively premium 3D CARTOON animation, smooth painted toy surfaces, generously rounded and slightly exaggerated forms, simple clean broad highlights, soft mint-green/coral/turquoise/violet/gold palette, consistent upper-left lighting and front-facing three-quarter orthographic view except explicitly top-down rover. Make shapes immediately readable at 40px. No photorealism, pores, fruit speckles, realistic leaf veins, metal scratches, microtexture, detailed flower petals or hard realism. Original artwork; no known game characters or logos. Transparent alpha background, NO checkerboard painted into the image. Keep objects fully within their cells; all twelve must appear exactly once and never overlap.
